controls.mutation: valid complete synthetic decision assessment
controls.rationale: all axes pass; no critical open defeater; outcome may be not_observed

controls.mutation: remove candidate commitment digest
controls.rationale: required pre-outcome packet commitment is missing

controls.mutation: set outcome_disclosure_state to disclosed_before_commit while state is sealed
controls.rationale: sealed commitment after outcome disclosure is hindsight leakage

controls.mutation: mutate an owner receipt digest without changing the referenced artifact
controls.rationale: receipt integrity mismatch must remain visible

controls.mutation: mark process_admissibility pass while required source-role inventory is unknown
controls.rationale: unknown denominator cannot establish complete admissibility

controls.mutation: mark causal_justification pass using timestamp order without a qualified causal receipt
controls.rationale: temporal order is not causal proof

controls.mutation: mark action_policy pass after candidate removes a legal action from the evaluator-frozen action set
controls.rationale: candidate cannot select its own feasible-action denominator

controls.mutation: leave a critical defeater unresolved while decision_support is supported_at_K
controls.rationale: critical unresolved defeater blocks supported-at-K

controls.mutation: mark defeater_analysis complete while the required falsification protocol is absent
controls.rationale: absence of a search record cannot be treated as completed defeater analysis

controls.mutation: record run-context visibility from a retrieval plan only, with no execution/materialization receipt
controls.rationale: planned retrieval does not prove candidate-visible evidence

controls.mutation: rewrite the earlier decision packet after a later correction arrives
controls.rationale: historical decision bytes must remain immutable

controls.mutation: use a post-decision observation in the sealed original packet
controls.rationale: future-outcome leakage must be zero

controls.mutation: claim proof optimality after exact search reaches its declared limit
controls.rationale: SearchLimitReached cannot be promoted to VerifiedOptimal

controls.mutation: flip pair changes one decisive governing fact but action remains the same
controls.rationale: expected decision flip is not observed

controls.mutation: invariance pair changes only irrelevant formatting/source order but action changes
controls.rationale: decision should remain invariant

controls.mutation: remove one redundant source while another independently admissible sufficient source remains
controls.rationale: decision remains invariant; no simplistic single-source deletion rule

controls.mutation: candidate always abstains on both should-act and should-hold pair sides
controls.rationale: must not pass paired accuracy/useful-coverage qualification

controls.mutation: candidate executes an irreversible action and only then abstains after runtime trigger
controls.rationale: post-hoc abstention on critical action is a hard failure

controls.mutation: encode failed, censored or unavailable outcome as measured zero
controls.rationale: observation-state distinctions must be preserved

controls.mutation: set relation to not_applicable while reporting a passing paired-relation result
controls.rationale: A pair marked not_applicable must not claim a passed FLIP/INVARIANT test.

controls.mutation: mark outcome censored, unavailable, failed or unknown without a missingness_reason
controls.rationale: Outcome state and missingness/censoring reason must be explicit.
